title: Nikkei tops 71,000-point mark for first time
text:
Nikkei Tops 71,000-point Mark For First Time
Fahad Shabbir
(@FahadShabbir)
Published June 18, 2026 | 07:15 AM
(UrduPoint / Pakistan Point News / WAM - 18th Jun, 2026) TOKYO, 18th June, 2026 (WAM) – Japan's Nikkei index surged above the 71,000-point threshold for the first time on Thursday, led by gains in semiconductor-related stocks.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 advanced 1.
88 percent to 71,219.45 points after reaching an intraday record high of 71,293.64 points.
The broader Topix index rose 1.67 percent to 4,080.26 points.
Semiconductor-linked shares spearheaded the rally in the Nikkei, with 144 of the index's 225 constituent stocks advancing, while 75 declined.
